Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-rays demonstrate a marked shift of the mediastinum and cardiac silhouette into the right hemithorax following right-sided surgery, which is characteristic of right-sided cardiac herniation through a pericardial defect. This mechanical displacement causes acute haemodynamic compromise by kinking the great vessels and impairing venous return.
